verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents on-demand, hardware-isolated VMs (Machines and Sprites) that boot in under a second, can be created with one command or a REST API, and scale out to tens of thousands, so isolated environments can be created at scale. However, no documented workflow presents these as per-developer or preview environments for a team shipping in parallel, and one hands-on report says staging-environment deploys failed 70-80% of the time. missing for 10: a documented per-developer/preview environment workflow, team-collaboration features for parallel shipping, independent corroboration of reliable environment provisioning at scale.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously

citations.quote: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.
Run it in a hardware-isolated VM. A clean baseline per request, so no two users ever share state.
The `fly machine run` command is a tool to configure, build, and start a new Machine in one line.
Every agent gets its own Linux box.
